edit_types.tense_voice: Tense alignment with academic section conventions and appropriate active/passive voice.
edit_types.article_preposition: Definite/indefinite articles (a/an/the) and academic prepositional collocations.
edit_types.syntax_clarity: Dangling modifiers, run-on sentence splitting, parallel structure, and clause flow.
edit_types.collocation_word_choice: Idiomatic academic lexical choice and precise domain verbs/nouns.
edit_types.terminology_consistency: Unifying cross-section terms against the active glossary and capitalization/hyphenation rules.
edit_types.abbreviation_standardization: Enforcing first-mention 'Full Name (ABBR)' and consistent subsequent use.
edit_types.register_tone: Removing colloquialisms, promotional hyperbole, improper person, or informal phrasing.
edit_types.hedge_calibration: Preserving or clarifying appropriate epistemic modality without inflating/weakening claims.
edit_types.chinglish_restructure: Eliminating literal translation patterns, redundant nominalization, and unnatural topic-subject framing.
edit_types.punctuation_formatting: Academic punctuation, hyphenation, spacing around units/citations, and markup hygiene.
edit_types.no_change: Sentence verified as accurate, consistent, and compliant; retained unchanged.

risk_levels.low: Purely mechanical grammar, article, punctuation, or deterministic glossary normalization.
risk_levels.medium: Clause restructuring, lexical substitution, or Chinglish/register revision preserving propositions.
risk_levels.high: Ambiguous source wording, glossary conflict, potential factual/unit ambiguity, or structural split requiring author confirmation.
